description: Find faults, isolate and switch, repair lines, and restore service, including storm restoration under the ERP
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Public and crew safety (downed lines, members on the medical-needs list, the county water plant and fire station); every hour without a working restoration process lengthens outages for all about 820 meters; storm overtime and mutual aid costs
manual_workaround: Crews patrol by feeder using paper circuit maps in each truck; switching by radio and cell phone; tickets kept on paper and entered later
dependent_systems: SYS-04 (outage management and mapping); SYS-03 (meter outage events); SYS-01; SYS-06 (truck tablets, smartphones)
dependent_third_parties: Business suite vendor; AMI vendor; hosted SCADA vendor; cellular carrier; G&T (delivery point status); after-hours call center
dependent_people_or_facilities: Line Superintendent; 2 Journeyman Lineworkers; Meter and Service Technician; trucks and warehouse

description: Watch Substation 1 and the 6 line reclosers; open, close, and change recloser settings remotely; respond to alarms after hours
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without SCADA nobody sees a feeder lockout until members call, and every switching step needs a truck roll; after 24 hours a lineworker must be posted at Substation 1, which the 4-person field staff cannot sustain; settings and the point database change rarely, so a 24-hour RPO is enough
manual_workaround: Post a lineworker at Substation 1 during storms or abnormal conditions; operate recloser controls locally at the device; rely on member calls and AMI outage events for visibility
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-06 (operations workstation, truck tablets); SYS-07 (settings files)

description: Take outage calls (office and after-hours call center), IVR outage reporting, outage map, medical-needs callbacks, and outage updates on social media
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Members on the medical-needs list must be reached during long outages; without tickets crews cannot find faults quickly; member trust and Board elections depend on outage communication
manual_workaround: Forward office lines to the Line Superintendent's cell phone; printed medical-needs list kept in the ERP binder; post updates from a staff phone
dependent_systems: SYS-04 (outage module, IVR, portal); SYS-03 (outage events); SYS-05; SYS-06
dependent_third_parties: Business suite vendor; after-hours call center; phone carrier; AMI vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Member Services Representative; Office and Finance Manager; headquarters

business_process: Metering, remote connect and disconnect, and load control
description: Read meters, connect and disconnect service remotely, verify outages and restorations by meter, and run the voluntary water-heater load-control program
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Meters store interval data for weeks, so billing reads can wait; remote connects for new or returning members can be done by truck; a wrongful mass disconnect is a safety issue (medical-needs members) and is covered under BP-02 and P01
manual_workaround: Field connects and disconnects by the Meter and Service Technician; estimated reads; skip load control for the month
dependent_people_or_facilities: Meter and Service Technician; 2 AMI collectors

description: Monthly billing, payment posting, deposits and new memberships, disconnect-for-nonpayment notices, member portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $92,000 billed a month; billing can slip 2 to 3 days; disconnects for nonpayment are suspended while billing is down, which the tariff allows
manual_workaround: Delay the billing run; take payments by the processor's hosted page and IVR (independent of the suite) and post later; suspend nonpayment disconnects
dependent_third_parties: Business suite vendor; card payment processor; bank
dependent_people_or_facilities: Office and Finance Manager; Member Services Representative

business_process: Wholesale power, peak management, and G&T coordination
description: Monitor the G&T's monthly coincident peak, send member peak alerts, run load-control events, and pay the monthly power bill
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A missed coincident peak hour costs about $6,300 in demand charges that month; the power bill (about $53,000) must be paid on time under the wholesale contract
manual_workaround: Watch the G&T's peak advisory emails and call the G&T control center; run load control from the AMI head-end by hand; pay by bank portal with callback verification
dependent_systems: SYS-03 (load management and peak-forecasting add-on); SYS-05; SYS-04 (accounting)
dependent_people_or_facilities: General Manager; Office and Finance Manager

description: General ledger, payroll every two weeks, vendor and contractor payments, RUS financial reporting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll every two weeks; RUS and lender reporting deadlines are monthly or longer; a cash reserve covers about 45 days
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll; pay urgent vendors by bank portal; catch up the ledger

business_process: Engineering records, mapping, and compliance records
description: Circuit maps and staking, inspection and test records, ERP and VRA, RUS Form 300 file, recloser and RTU settings files
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Needed for planning and the 2027 RUS review, not for daily operations; trucks carry paper maps; settings files are needed only when a device must be replaced or restored (covered by BP-02)
manual_workaround: Paper maps in the trucks; paper ERP binder; request copies from the business suite vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Line Superintendent; Office and Finance Manager
